caption: The drawing features a single bonnet, oriented to show the left side and front. The main body of the bonnet is straw-colored with fine vertical lines suggesting a woven texture. The brim is prominently outlined with a wide pink ribbon that forms a large, loose bow with long ribbon ends hanging down. The edges of the bonnet’s brim are trimmed with black and white, with a decorative black pattern along the ribbon. On the left side of the bonnet, near the ear area, there is a cluster of small red or pink flowers attached. The interior of the brim is lightly shaded, giving a sense of depth, and there is an additional small band or ribbon inside the bonnet, also in pink. The background of the image is plain and off-white with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Bonnet
